newsitem.title: UK: New Rothschild fund targets nervous investors.
newsitem.headline: New Rothschild fund targets nervous investors.

text.p: Rothschild Asset Manangement on Monday launched a money market fund aimed at cash-rich institutions and professionals concerned about the security of their capital.

"It's our hunch that a lot of money is being generated by institutions, both in the U.S. and elsewhere," Rothschild Asset Management managing director Peter Collacott told Reuters Financial Television.
"We are coming across periodically problems at banks, starting off a number of years ago when BCCI got themselves into trouble...then Barings ran into problems.
"While not forseeing what could or could not happen with another banking problem in London, we are cognisant of the fact that Natwest had problems in their dealing rooms.
He also noted warnings on Monday by the Bank of England about large bonuses to traders which depend on their dealing activities.

The launch follows an announcement by National Westminster Bank Plc on Friday that it had suspended a senior dealer following a loss on options trading. It said it would take a 50 million stg charge to cover the loss.

"The AAAm-rated fund is being launched at a time when professional investors are more concerned than ever about the safety of assets and the need to spread these among a diverse group of institutions," Rothschild said in a statement.

It said the Dublin-based Five Arrows Cash Management Fund would target investors outside the U.S. and offered a choice of four sub-funds -- dollar, sterling, mark and Canadian dollar. A similar fund is bering offered in the U.S.

Each sub-fund will invest indirectly in international money market instruments, including certificates of deposit, commercial paper, bank deposits, repurchase agreements, floating rate notes, treasury bills and short-dated government securities and short-term corporate debt securities.

The company said the rating indicated the fund's "excellent safety" and its superior capacity to maintain principal value and limit exposure to loss. The AAAm rating is the highest that a fund of this type can achieve.
The minimum investment in the fund is $500,000.
